item.subject: science
item.stem:
The diagram shows two circuits Hamza builds with the same nichrome wire. Circuit P uses one cell. Circuit Q uses two cells in series. He closes each switch for the same short time.

Which claim correctly compares the heating and judges its use?

options.A: The wire in Q heats more than in P; that heating can be useful in a heater but harmful if it melts insulation.
options.B: The wire in P heats more than in Q because one cell always produces more heat than two.
options.C: Both wires heat equally because the wire is the same, so the number of cells does not matter.
options.D: Q heats more, so the heating is always useful and never harmful in any situation.
